meta.name: rank-tracking
meta.description: Rank tracking without a tracker subscription — position movers between any two periods from real Search Console data. Use when asked "how are my rankings", "what moved this week/month", "track my keywords", or "did the update hit me".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对比两个时段,从真实搜索数据看清关键词排名的涨跌进出
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你运营网站,想弄清关键词排名为何变动,又不想买第三方排名工具
copy.tagline_en: Compare keyword rankings across two periods straight from real search data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run a site and want to see why rankings moved without a paid tracker

howto.what: 它从 Google Search Console 拉取两个时间段的真实排名数据，比对后先给一句结论，再列出上升、下降、新增、消失的查询及位置、点击变化。
howto.when: 当你问“我的排名怎么样”、“这周/这个月哪些词有变化”等关键词表现问题，或想确认某次算法更新是否影响到你时触发。

say.note: 用近 28 天对比前 28 天

say.text: 三月更新之后，哪些关键词掉得最多？
say.note: 按你给的日期切分两个时间段

say.text: 这周哪些页面排名变化最大？
say.note: 换成页面维度做同样的对比

howto.what_en: It pulls real Search Console data for two periods, diffs them, and gives a verdict plus four tables: winners, losers, new, and lost queries with position and click changes.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask how your rankings are, what moved this week or month, want your keywords tracked, or ask whether an algorithm update hit you.

say_en.text: Which keywords dropped since the March update?
say_en.note: Splits the windows around your date

say_en.text: Which pages moved most this week?
